## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Codebase cleanup / refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have verified that client build passes (`cd client && npm run build:all`).
- [ ] I have verified that server compilation passes (`cd server && npm run build`).
- [ ] I have run the test suite and verified all tests pass (`cd server && npm test`).
- [ ] No private environment files (`.env`), API keys, credentials, or personal database dumps are committed.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly if applicable.
